family: Restriction closure of fresh fair half-activations and disjoint finite products of signed point defects over a base GU' class.

credit.owner: The physical singleton coordinate at its current node.
credit.first_revelation_rule: At A(q), charge the complete scalar midpoint logarithm for coordinate i to its current Phi(q) summand.
credit.nonreuse_mechanism: Every inherited summand contracts by rho=(1+ln2)/4<1/2, while the GU recursion discounts the parent potential by exactly 1/2; lambda=4/(1-ln2) makes 1+lambda*rho-lambda/2=0.
credit.new_selector_credit: phi((1-Eq)/2)<=M(1-Eq)/2, paid by the new physical selector influence.
credit.new_disjoint_defect_credit: Phi(Bh)-Phi(h)<=M I(B), paid once by the fresh defect-block influence.

terminal_term: The invariant retains bU(f) at every node; no terminal U is discarded in the GU' induction.
unpaid: Shared-variable products and coherent overlap, where exact product additivity and the displayed Phi product bound fail.
